instagram.caption:
Working from home with ADHD: 3 tiny tasks due by 5 ⏳

One email. One invoice. My timesheet.

40 minutes later I'd reorganized my whole desk. I'm not lazy. I just can't start.

So I said it out loud to FOCO. It put all 3 in my afternoon and gave me one tiny first step: open Sam's email. 1 minute. All 3 were done by 4:02, coffee still warm.

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting.

📌 Save this for your next deadline.
💜 The app is FOCO.
